note: What the sources of the sound comparison are asked for. Four families of short events, the ones the owner has rejected in every form so far. A model gets each prompt as it stands (an adapter may add what its makers recommend, for example a prefix, and says so in its record) with each seed, and returns 'seconds' of audio; the event is cut out of that afterwards. Prompts describe a real sound a microphone could record, because that is what the models were trained on; 'spaceship' words are kept out except where no real sound exists (the shield). 'lufs' is the level every candidate of a family gets on the page: the level of the direction samples of round 3, so that old and new can be compared.

families.what: Something heavy hits the ship's hull from outside; heard inside.

prompts.text: A heavy object slams into a large steel ship hull, deep boom and a hard metallic clang, heard from inside, resonant
Sledgehammer hits a thick steel tank, single hit, deep thud with ringing metal, close microphone
Massive impact on a metal shipping container, low-end thump, metal rattling briefly afterwards

families.what: A manoeuvring thruster fires for a fraction of a second.

prompts.text: Short sharp burst of compressed gas from a pneumatic valve, a punchy hiss with a low thump, single burst
Air cannon fires once, short powerful blast of air, close microphone
Solenoid valve clacks open and a short jet of gas shoots out, then the valve snaps shut

families.what: The landing gear extends and locks.

prompts.text: Heavy hydraulic landing gear extending, electric servo motor whine, then a solid metal clunk as it locks
Large industrial hydraulic actuator moves for two seconds and locks into place with a heavy clunk
Big electric motor drives a heavy mechanism, gears turning, ending with a loud latch

families.what: A shot hits the ship's energy shield.

prompts.text: Energy shield absorbs an impact, deep bass whoomp with crackling electricity, science fiction force field hit
Powerful electric arc discharge with a deep sub-bass thump and electric sizzle fading out
Force field struck by a projectile, low humming pulse and a burst of electrical crackle
